scope: All existing 3200 final responses; exact structural negatives and all 769 structural candidates judged by both additional evaluators.
uncertainty: Paired family bootstrap conditional on each evaluator; not an estimate of evaluator error. Bonferroni intervals across eight evaluator-by-context contrasts.
